description: Repairs r-sort-3/create-keys-accdb: CREATE INDEX IX_FKND ON FR returned 0x800A0D2F because IX_FKNd already exists (index names are case-insensitive), so walking "IX_FKND" in keys-order-index-accdb walked IX_FKNd again and the (K, N, D) index was untested. Fixture (ACCDB), CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128). FR(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(20), N Long, D Double) with the original 60 rows (K over Null, empty, marker-like and embedded-null values; N over Null, 0, 1, 256, -1, -256; D paired with N), stored through a table-type recordset; then the seven compound indexes with distinct names: IX_FKN (K, N), IX_FNK (N, K), IX_FKdN (K DESC, N), IX_FKNd (K, N DESC), IX_FNdKd (N DESC, K DESC), IX_FKN3 (K, N, D) and IX_FDK (D, K), each with dbFailOnError and DBEngine.Errors. Reads the refreshed index metadata of FR, the IX_FKN3 walk forward and backward, the IX_FKNd walk (the one the original walked by mistake), and SQL ORDER BY K, N, D.

args.text: CREATE TABLE FR (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FR PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(20), N LONG, D DOUBLE)
CREATE INDEX IX_FKN ON FR (K, N)
CREATE INDEX IX_FNK ON FR (N, K)
CREATE INDEX IX_FKdN ON FR (K DESC, N)
CREATE INDEX IX_FKNd ON FR (K, N DESC)
CREATE INDEX IX_FNdKd ON FR (N DESC, K DESC)
CREATE INDEX IX_FKN3 ON FR (K, N, D)
CREATE INDEX IX_FDK ON FR (D, K)
SELECT ID FROM FR ORDER BY K, N, D
